requirement: All required module, summary, reference, and intermediate directories exist
Published manifest sample IDs equal supplied manifest and metadata IDs
rationale: Detects dropped, duplicated, or mismatched samples

requirement: Every supplied contaminant and mitochondrial truth feature is identified and absent from the final microbial table
rationale: Validates local BLAST and non-target filtering

requirement: At least one microbial ASV receives a non-empty taxonomy assignment
At least one FDR-significant Type_Group or Case indicator matches an implanted group-effect ASV
rationale: Demonstrates recovery of known group structure

requirement: At least one implanted positive ASV-VOC pair is recovered with rho >= 0.30
The inferred graph has at least 10 edges, a multi-node module, and at least one edge within an implanted module
rationale: Rejects an uninformative or fully truth-discordant network

requirement: Every plot-producing showcase module emits at least one SVG
Every module file listed in module_output_manifest.tsv exists and matches its SHA-256
rationale: Detects incomplete or altered publication outputs
